units.source: Icon Packs
units.context: Icon Packs

units.source: By default, Trilium comes with a set of icons called Boxicons v2. Since v0.102.0, custom icon packs allow a wider selection of icons for notes.
units.context: Icon Packs

units.source: Icon packs are specific to Trilium, so they must either be created from scratch (see below) or imported from a ZIP file from a third-party developer.
units.context: Icon Packs

units.source: Sample icon packs__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Icon Packs > Sample icon packs

units.source: The Trilium team maintains a few icon packs that are not shipped with Trilium. These icon packs can be found on the official website on the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Resources page__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Icon Packs > Sample icon packs

units.source: Importing an existing icon pack__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Icon Packs > Importing an existing icon pack

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Icon packs are third-party content__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Icon Packs > Importing an existing icon pack

units.source: Apart from the __TRILIUM_PH_0__sample icon packs__TRILIUM_PH_1__, the Trilium maintainers are not responsible for keeping icon packs up to date. If you have an issue with a specific icon pack, then the issue must be reported to the third-party developer responsible for it, not the Trilium team.
units.context: Icon Packs > Importing an existing icon pack

units.source: To import an icon pack:
units.context: Icon Packs > Importing an existing icon pack

units.source: Ideally, create a dedicated spot in your note tree where to place the icon packs.
units.context: Icon Packs > Importing an existing icon pack

units.source: Right click the note where to put it and select __TRILIUM_PH_0__Import into note__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Icon Packs > Importing an existing icon pack

units.source: Uncheck __TRILIUM_PH_0__Safe import__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Icon Packs > Importing an existing icon pack

units.source: Select __TRILIUM_PH_0__Import__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Icon Packs > Importing an existing icon pack

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Refresh the application__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Icon Packs > Importing an existing icon pack

units.source: Since __TRILIUM_PH_0__Safe import__TRILIUM_PH_1__ is disabled, make sure you trust the source as it could contain dangerous third-party scripts. One good way to check if the icon pack is safe is to manually extract the .zip and inspect the file contents. Icon packs should only contain a font file and a JSON file. Other files (especially scripts) are to be considered harmful.
units.context: Icon Packs > Importing an existing icon pack

units.source: Creating an icon pack__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Icon Packs > Creating an icon pack

units.source: Creating an icon pack requires some scripting knowledge outside Trilium in order to generate the list of icons. For information, see __TRILIUM_PH_0__Creating an icon pack__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Icon Packs > Creating an icon pack

units.source: Using an icon from an icon pack__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Icon Packs > Using an icon from an icon pack

units.source: After __TRILIUM_PH_0__refreshing the application__TRILIUM_PH_1__, the icon pack should be enabled by default. To test this, simply select an existing note or create a new one and try to change the note icon.
units.context: Icon Packs > Using an icon from an icon pack

units.source: There should be a __TRILIUM_PH_0__Filter__TRILIUM_PH_1__ button to the right of the search bar in the icon list. Clicking it allows filtering by icon pack and the newly imported icon pack should be displayed there.
units.context: Icon Packs > Using an icon from an icon pack

units.source: If the icon pack is missing from that list, then most likely there's something wrong with it.
units.context: Icon Packs > Using an icon from an icon pack

units.source: Try checking the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Backend (server) logs__TRILIUM_PH_1__ for clues and make sure that the icon pack has the __TRILIUM_PH_2__ __TRILIUM_PH_3__label__TRILIUM_PH_4__ with a value assigned to it (a prefix).
units.context: Icon Packs > Using an icon from an icon pack

units.source: Icon packs that are __TRILIUM_PH_0__protected__TRILIUM_PH_1__ are ignored.
units.context: Icon Packs > Using an icon from an icon pack

units.source: Integration with the share and export functionality__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Icon Packs > Integration with the share and export functionality

units.source: Custom icon packs are also supported by the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Sharing__TRILIUM_PH_1__ feature, where they will be shown in the note tree. However, in order for an icon pack to be visible to the share function, the icon pack note must also be shared.
units.context: Icon Packs > Integration with the share and export functionality

units.source: If you are using a custom share theme, make sure it supports the __TRILIUM_PH_0__, otherwise icons will not show up. Check the original share template source code for reference.
units.context: Icon Packs > Integration with the share and export functionality

units.source: Custom icon packs will also be preserved when __TRILIUM_PH_0__Exporting static HTML for web publishing__TRILIUM_PH_1__. In this case, there's no requirement to make the icon pack shared.
units.context: Icon Packs > Integration with the share and export functionality

units.source: What happens if I remove an icon pack__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Icon Packs > What happens if I remove an icon pack

units.source: If an icon pack is removed or disabled (by removing or altering its __TRILIUM_PH_0__ label), all the notes that use this icon pack will show in the __TRILIUM_PH_1__Note Tree__TRILIUM_PH_2__ with no icon. This won't cause any issues apart from looking strange.
units.context: Icon Packs > What happens if I remove an icon pack

units.source: The solution is to replace the icons with some else, try using __TRILIUM_PH_0__Search__TRILIUM_PH_1__ which supports bulk actions, to identify the notes with the now deleted icon pack (by looking for the prefix) and changing or removing their __TRILIUM_PH_2__.
units.context: Icon Packs > What happens if I remove an icon pack
